dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D body plane from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary grey baseline and the mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast vertical white linear mark is visible on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single linear hypopigmented mark (likely a rake mark) located on the posterior dorsal ridge.
